The Lab/2014

TLDR;Tech

May–June 2014 · Design & development

A tech news blog I started with two friends, with short summaries and a theme I designed.

Dates & sources

I linked to tldrte.ch in a blog post on 28 May 2014. The earliest Wayback homepage capture is dated 2 June 2014; the screenshot shows news from 5 June. These are surviving records, not a confirmed launch date.

Archived site · 2 June 2014 ↗My notes on building the theme ↗

Two friends and I started TLDR;Tech to publish short tech news summaries. I spent a lot of time on the design and building the theme, but we only kept it going for a few weeks.

The screenshot is from June 2014. Wayback also has the homepage, with our news posts and the original design.
